title: Fair Allocation with Optional Selling
abstract: arXiv:2608.24600v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider fair allocation of indivisible goods in a setting in which agents have subjective valuation functions over the set of goods, and in addition, goods may be sold at given market prices. In this setting, a fair allocation involves {deciding which goods to sell, how to allocate the unsold goods, and how to divide the money received from the sold goods.} We adapt to this setting the definitions of share-based fairness notions, such as the maximin share (MMS) and the truncated proportional share (TPS), and comparison-based fairness notions such as EF1 and EFX (which we adapt to SEF1 and SEFX). translated_title: 可选销售下的公平分配
translated_abstract: 我们考虑在一种设置中不可分割商品的公平分配问题，其中代理人对商品集合具有主观估值函数，此外，商品可以按给定市场价格出售。在这种设置下，公平分配涉及{决定哪些商品出售，如何分配未售出的商品，以及如何分配出售商品所得的资金。}我们将基于份额的公平概念（如最大最小份额（MMS）和截断比例份额（TPS））以及基于比较的公平概念（如EF1和EFX，我们将其调整为SEF1和SEFX）适应于此设置。当每个代理人的效用对商品和金钱均为可加时，我们展示了以下结果。对于两个代理人，存在同时满足MMS和SEFX的分配。对于三个代理人，存在实例使得任何分配都无法给每个代理人超过$\frac{11}{12}$-MMS。对于任意数量的代理人，存在$\frac{2}{3}$-MMS的分配。
tldr: 本文提出在商品可出售的公平分配框架中，调整公平概念，并证明两代理人可实现MMS与SEFX同时满足，三代理人存在严格上界，任意人数可达到2/3-MMS。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces fair allocation with optional selling, adapting fairness notions, and shows two-agent MMS+SEFX existence, a tight 11/12-MMS bound for three agents, and universal 2/3-MMS guarantees.
